messages.subject: Shiny to update values on Submit button
parts:
Refer to my Shiny deployment at https://tanthiamhuat.shinyapps.io/OnlineSurvey1/
I need some help to modify the application.

I need to update the value of "Accumulated MRT results so far", which at present is not correct, or using the correct formulae.

say for example, before the Submit button is pressed, the value of "Accumulated MRT results so far" is 50%, with the value of "Total submitted so far" is 5, that means you are the 6th user who comes in that above website, and choose to rate the MRT transport system in Country XXX as 60%.

When the Submit button is pressed, the value of "Total submitted so far" would increase by one to show a value of 6, and the value of "Accumulated MRT results so far" would be equal to (50*5 + 60)/6 = 310/6 = 51.67%.

How should I modify my attached code to cater to the above requirements?
Also, I need to ensure that every single PC unique to their IP Address can only submit the survey only once, is that possible?

thank you.
